speaker.name: Model Monica
speaker.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

output.objection: I did not ask for a simple log of which version ran last week. I need the registry to automatically capture the exact data slice, feature store state, and training hyperparameters so I can reproduce any forecast failure without guessing.
output.correction: You are treating this as a documentation gap, but it is a reproducibility requirement. If I cannot prove that a specific set of inputs produced the current model weights, we cannot trust the audit trail when a promotion week goes wrong.
